annotations.title: Forecast LinkedIn ad delivery before you spend

description: LINKEDIN'S OWN DELIVERY FORECAST for a targeting spec and a budget, before any campaign exists: impressions, clicks, spend, reach, leads, video views and the cost and per-million rates LinkedIn returns, each with a low-high range, per day and for the whole window. Pass targeting (locations plus optional include / exclude facets: search_linkedin_ads_targeting resolves names to URNs, free), dailyBudget or totalBudget (account currency), objectiveType (LinkedIn refuses a forecast without one), and EITHER bidType + bidAmount (a manual bid) OR optimizationTarget (automated bidding). Optional campaignType (SPONSORED_UPDATES default, SPONSORED_INMAILS, DYNAMIC), startDate / endDate (default the next 30 days from tomorrow, UTC; must be in the future), audienceNetwork, audienceExpansion. A forecast is an estimate, not a promise; *_PER_MILLION_* values are rates per one million. Pair with linkedin_audience_count and linkedin_bid_pricing. Read-only, spends nothing.

adAccountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id; omit for the selected one

bidType.description: manual bid: CPM, CPC or CPV

campaignId.description: an existing campaign, for a sharper forecast

currency.description: ISO code; default the account currency

exclude.description: facets to exclude, same shape as include

excludeLocations.description: geo URNs or bare ids to exclude

include.description: more facets to target, e.g. {titles:[…], industries:[…], seniorities:[…]}

locations.description: geo URNs or bare ids to target

objectiveType.description: REQUIRED by LinkedIn: e.g. WEBSITE_VISIT, LEAD_GENERATION, BRAND_AWARENESS, VIDEO_VIEW, ENGAGEMENT, WEBSITE_CONVERSION

optimizationTarget.description: automated bidding target, e.g. MAX_IMPRESSION, MAX_CLICK, MAX_LEAD, TARGET_COST_PER_CLICK, CAP_COST_AND_MAXIMIZE_CLICKS

targetingCriteria.description: LinkedIn's raw targetingCriteria (include/exclude), instead of the friendly fields
